title: Positivity of the face integral of a nonnegative continuous function positive at a relative-interior point
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, F = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N (z ∈ ℤ^N, α : Fin n ↪o Fin N strictly increasing), g : ℝ^N → ℝ continuous with g(x) ≥ 0 for all x, and p ∈ ℝ^N with g(p) > 0. Assume p lies in the relative interior of the face: ρ z_i < p_i < ρ(z_i + 1) for every i ∈ range α, and p_i = ρ z_i for every i ∉ range α. Then 0 < ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} g dH^n, where H^n = μHE[n] is the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (g : Eucl N → ℝ) (p : Eucl N), 0 < ρ → Continuous g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → 0 < g p → (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range F.2 → ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ) < p i ∧ p i < ρ * ((F.1 i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ range F.2 → p i = ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ))) → 0 < ∫ x in latticeFace ρ F, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N))
